pr_title: Fix race when handling delegating tasks in ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine
pr_body:
Motivation:

Due incorrect handling of delegating tasks in ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine it was possible to observe handshake timeouts / failures.

Modification:

- Only reset needsTask variable after we actually ran the task.
- Add missing synchronized as otherwise we might end up calling native code concurrently which is not safe.
- Change how we excute delegating tasks in our SSLEngineTest. This change would result in timeouts / failures before the fix.

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/12139
pr_comments: @chrisvest I opened a PR against 4.1 and main to proof that for both cases all works.

issue_context.title: Delegated tasks issue in ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine
issue_context.body:
Sometimes the OpenSSL engine fails to properly handle delegated tasks.
The cause of problems is probably a thread-safety issue in the `io.netty.handler.ssl.ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine` class.

Executing the delegated tasks in a blocking manner seems to work correctly.

If the tasks are executed in external threads the processing sometimes fails. The handshake "hangs" in the `NEED_TASK` state.


### Expected behavior

All delegated tasks are properly finished and the handshake status in the `SSLEngine` gets value different from the `NEED_TASK`.

### Actual behavior

Sometimes the `ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine` hangs in the `NEED_TASK` handshake status.

### Steps to reproduce

Repeat the reproducer runs until it hits the issue:
```bash
i=1; while mvn test; do echo "Starting build $((++i))"; done; echo "Failed $i"
```

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)

The reproducer is in this branch:
https://github.com/kwart/test-app/tree/netty-tcnative-NEED_TASK-issue

The main class `App.java` can be switched from using the non-blocking task executor to blocking by:

```diff
-        app.run(false);
+        app.run(true);
```

In this case, we didn't hit see the problem occur.

### Netty version

Tested with the latest available:

```xml
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.netty</groupId>
            <artifactId>netty-tcnative-boringssl-static</artifactId>
            <version>2.0.50.Final</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.netty</groupId>
            <artifactId>netty-handler</artifactId>
            <version>4.1.74.Final</version>
        </dependency>
```

We hit the problem in the older netty versions too.

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)

We tested this on Linux OpenJDK versions 8, 11, 17. Most often we hit the problem on Java 11, less often on 8, and sometimes
on 17.

```
$ j8
openjdk version "1.8.0_312"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (Zulu 8.58.0.13-CA-linux64) (build 1.8.0_312-b07)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (Zulu 8.58.0.13-CA-linux64) (build 25.312-b07, mixed mode)
$ j11
openjdk version "11.0.13" 2021-10-19 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Zulu11.52+13-CA (build 11.0.13+8-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Zulu11.52+13-CA (build 11.0.13+8-LTS, mixed mode)
$ j17
openjdk version "17" 2021-09-14 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Zulu17.28+13-CA (build 17+35-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Zulu17.28+13-CA (build 17+35-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)
```

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)
Ubuntu 20.04

```bash
$ uname -a
Linux kwart-office 5.4.0-100-generic #113-Ubuntu SMP Thu Feb 3 18:43:29 UTC 2022 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
```
